title: Tool Utilities
summary: This module provides utilities for managing and loading tools, including extracting tool specifications and loading various data formats for RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) purposes.

nodes.label: ToolSpecExtractor
nodes.title: Tool Specification Extractor
nodes.description: Extracts detailed specifications, including parameters, environment variables, and package dependencies, from defined tools for documentation and validation.

nodes.label: BaseAgentTool
nodes.title: Base Agent Tool
nodes.description: Provides a foundational class for tools that interact with agents, including methods for sanitizing agent names and executing delegated tasks.

nodes.label: Base Tool Utilities
nodes.title: Base Tool Utilities
nodes.description: Offers core functionalities for tool management, such as converting tools to and from Langchain format, validating tool schemas, and handling asynchronous execution.

nodes.label: CSVLoader
nodes.title: CSV Loader
nodes.description: Loads and parses content from CSV files or URLs, extracting structured data and metadata for RAG.

nodes.label: DirectoryLoader
nodes.title: Directory Loader
nodes.description: Recursively loads and processes files from a specified directory, supporting filtering by extension and file limits for RAG.

nodes.label: JSONLoader
nodes.title: JSON Loader
nodes.description: Loads and parses JSON content from files or URLs, converting it into a readable text format for RAG.

nodes.label: MDXLoader
nodes.title: MDX Loader
nodes.description: Loads and cleans MDX (Markdown with JSX) content from files or URLs, removing JSX tags and formatting for RAG.

nodes.label: MySQLLoader
nodes.title: MySQL Loader
nodes.description: Connects to a MySQL database and loads data based on a provided SQL query, formatting the results for RAG.

nodes.label: PDFLoader
nodes.title: PDF Loader
nodes.description: Loads and extracts text content from PDF files or URLs, handling downloads and parsing for RAG.

nodes.label: PostgresLoader
nodes.title: PostgresLoader
nodes.description: Connects to a PostgreSQL database and loads data based on a provided SQL query, formatting the results for RAG.

nodes.label: XMLLoader
nodes.title: XML Loader
nodes.description: Loads and parses XML content from files or URLs, extracting text and metadata for RAG.

nodes.label: Tool Definitions
nodes.title: Tool Definitions
nodes.description: Defines a wide array of specialized tools for various tasks, including web scraping, data search, and interaction with external services.

nodes.label: RAG System
nodes.title: Retrieval Augmented Generation System
nodes.description: Manages the core components for Retrieval Augmented Generation, including client factories, embedding functions, and collection management for vector databases.

nodes.label: Agent Management
nodes.title: Agent Management
nodes.description: Handles the creation, configuration, and execution of agents, including their interaction with tools and other agents.

groups.label: Tool Management
groups.title: Tool Management
groups.description: Components responsible for defining, extracting specifications, and providing base functionalities for various tools.

groups.label: RAG Data Loaders
groups.title: RAG Data Loaders
groups.description: A collection of loaders designed to ingest and process data from diverse sources (files, databases, URLs) for Retrieval Augmented Generation.
